p: The root of Idolatry is when men think that God is not present, unless they see him physically.
Break off the golden earrings: Thinking that they would rather abandon idolatry, than give up their most precious jewels.
golden earrings which were in their: Such is the rage of idolaters, that they spare no cost to satisfy their wicked desires.
molten calf: They remembered the sins of Egypt, where they saw calves, oxen and serpents worshipped.
have turned aside quickly out of: By which we see the need we have to pray earnestly to God, to keep us in his true obedience, and to send us good guides.
therefore let me alone: God shows that the prayers of the godly hold back his punishment.
Abraham: That is, your promise made to Abraham.
the writing was the writing of: All these repetitions show how excellent a thing they defrauded themselves of by their idolatry.
drink of it: Partly to despise them for their idolatry, and partly so they would have no opportunity to remember the calf later.
naked: Both destitute of God's favour, and an occasion for their enemies to speak evil of their God.
slay every man his brother: This fact did so please God, that he turned the curse of Jacob against Levi to a blessing, De 33:9.
son: In revenging God's glory we must have no partiality to person, but lay aside all carnal affection.
out of thy book which thou: He esteemed the glory of God so much, that he preferred it even to his own salvation.
book: I will make it known that he was never predestined in my eternal counsel to life everlasting.
Therefore now go: This demonstrates how grievous a sin idolatry is, seeing that at Moses prayer God would not fully remit it.
